text: siyā bhante idānāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisittoti . yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ gahapati bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisittoti . idhāhaṃ bhante yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃ( upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ . ekamantaṃ nisinno khohaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ etadavocaṃ ahamasmi bhante jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇātaṅko aniccadassāvī kho panāhaṃ bhante bhagavato manobhāvanīyānañca bhikkhūnaṃ ovadatu maṃ
